label: NER-CT-004
size_basis: estimated typical embroidered patch width 3 in (group, squadron and activity patches 3 in); the official digital artwork carries no physical size; height follows the artwork's own aspect
citation: CAPR 39-1 para 10.9 / Attachment 8 define the patch but give no dimensions
provenance: Unit emblem of 103rd Composite Squadron (NER-CT-004), digital artwork supplied by Ethan Hillard on 2026-11-10. Official digital artwork shipped as given: webp (VP8L lossless) -> png via dwebp; the file came without transparency on a plain white ground: the white outside the emblem's own outline was made transparent (connected from the image border, white at 250 or more of 255; 357042 px) and the 3580 edge pixels blended with that white were given their coverage as alpha; then trimmed to its alpha bounding box (1123 x 1200 px to 1041 x 1200 px), no resampling, no colour change.
notes: Official digital artwork as given, not a redraw: no thread texture added, nothing re-drawn or re-coloured. The only change is the white ground outside the outline, made transparent so the emblem sits on the garment.
